label: Airtable Access
description: Connect an Airtable account: sign in through Airtable's consent page (picking which bases the connection can reach), or paste a personal access token. Wire the access output into every Airtable node.

permissions.label: Read records
permissions.description: Read records out of the shared bases.

permissions.label: Write records
permissions.description: Create and change records in the shared bases.

permissions.label: List bases and tables
permissions.description: See the shared bases' names and table layouts (what the pickers browse).

steps: Open airtable.com/create/tokens and create a personal access token.
Give it the data.records:read, data.records:write, and schema.bases:read scopes, and add the bases it should reach.
Paste it below and name the connection.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: The Airtable access: wire it into the Airtable nodes.
